race.comment: CHATEAU VEGA (8) fought on well to finish second last start over 2200m at this track, beaten half a length. Has her share of ability, should be at peak fitness now and is drawn beautifully. WINTER GRACE (1) has good form and wound up strongly to score last time out over 2200m at this track. Tackles the same trip here and should be tough to stop again. BLUE ISMAY (6) was below his best last time, finishing 10th, beaten 12 lengths over 2040m at Seymour. Perfectly placed back to this grade and is sure to take a ton of beating. OUTDRIVE (3) pushed forward from a wide draw last time out and was prominent for a long way before fading to finish fifth over 2040m at Seymour. Has four runs under the belt now, so should be ready for a peak performance.
